lines.zh: 我用漏斗喷水，往后游。
lines.en: I jet water through my siphon and swim backwards.

lines.zh: 触手先伸，身体才跟上。
lines.en: The tentacles reach first; the body follows.

lines.zh: 我的皮肤在水里一闪一闪。
lines.en: My skin shimmers as I move through water.

lines.zh: 海草太密，我贴着沙底走。
lines.en: The kelp is thick; I keep to the sandy bottom.

lines.zh: 光从水面照下来，我躲开它。
lines.en: Light comes down from the surface, and I avoid it.

lines.zh: 我游得慢，但从不走直线。
lines.en: I swim slowly, but never in a straight line.

lines.zh: 一群小鱼从我的触手间穿过。
lines.en: A school of small fish passes between my tentacles.

lines.zh: 水变冷了，说明前面很深。
lines.en: The water turns cold, which means it gets deep.

lines.zh: 我把触手收拢，游得更快。
lines.en: I draw my tentacles in and swim faster.

lines.zh: 珊瑚的边缘很利，我绕过去。
lines.en: The coral edge is sharp, so I go around it.

lines.zh: 水压着我的身体，形状变扁了。
lines.en: The water presses me and my shape flattens.

lines.zh: 顺着海流走，省力一些。
lines.en: Riding the current is easier on my strength.

lines.zh: 底下有洞，我钻进去看看。
lines.en: There is a hole below; I slip inside to look.

lines.zh: 我的影子在沙上晃来晃去。
lines.en: My shadow sways back and forth on the sand.

lines.zh: 我喷一口水，往海草丛深处钻。
lines.en: I jet a mouthful of water and slip into the seagrass.

lines.zh: 我的颜色变淡，融进这片蓝里。
lines.en: My colours fade until I blend into the blue.

lines.zh: 我停在水中，触手慢慢摆。
lines.en: I hover in the water, tentacles swaying slowly.

lines.zh: 我的光很淡，像水面上的油。
lines.en: My shine is faint, like oil on the surface.

lines.zh: 我在听礁石后面的声音。
lines.en: I listen to the sounds behind the reef.

lines.zh: 有只螃蟹在沙里挖洞，很吵。
lines.en: A crab is digging in the sand, noisily.

lines.zh: 我把一条触手缠在水草上。
lines.en: I wrap one tentacle around a weed.

lines.zh: 水里没有镜子，我看不见自己。
lines.en: There is no mirror in water; I cannot see myself.

lines.zh: 我吐了一点墨，又停住。
lines.en: I release a little ink, then stop.

lines.zh: 这条海沟我住很久了。
lines.en: I have lived in this trench a long time.

lines.zh: 我慢慢开合身体，像在呼吸。
lines.en: I open and close my body slowly, like breathing.

lines.zh: 上面有船的声音，我不上去。
lines.en: There is a boat above; I will not go up.

lines.zh: 我的触手尖在水里发亮。
lines.en: The tips of my tentacles glow in the water.

lines.zh: 沙子落在我身上，我抖了抖。
lines.en: Sand settles on me, and I shake it off.

lines.zh: 我在等夜里，那时水更安静。
lines.en: I wait for night, when the water is quieter.

lines.zh: 我的皮肤一闪，是在跟同伴说话。
lines.en: When my skin flashes, I am talking to my kin.

lines.zh: 你的网兜在水面晃，我看见了。
lines.en: Your net sways on the surface; I see it.

lines.zh: 你潜下来，气泡挡住了我的眼睛。
lines.en: You dive, and your bubbles hide my eyes.

lines.zh: 你在水里比在陆上笨。
lines.en: You are clumsier in water than on land.

lines.zh: 我的触手碰到你的脚踝了。
lines.en: My tentacle has touched your ankle.

lines.zh: 你手里的桶，我看得见。
lines.en: That bucket in your hand, I can see it.

lines.zh: 别伸手，我会先跑。
lines.en: Do not reach out; I will flee first.

lines.zh: 船底下的影子，是我在发光。
lines.en: The shadow under your boat is me, glowing.

lines.zh: 我绕着你游了一圈，很远。
lines.en: I circled you once, at a distance.

lines.zh: 你的影子落在水底，我躲开了。
lines.en: Your shadow falls to the seabed, and I avoid it.

lines.zh: 你在看我身上的光。
lines.en: You are looking at the shine on my skin.

lines.zh: 疼，我把触手全缩回去了。
lines.en: It hurts; I have pulled every tentacle in.

lines.zh: 我的墨喷出来，水全黑了。
lines.en: My ink bursts out and the water goes black.

lines.zh: 你划破了我的一块皮。
lines.en: You cut through a patch of my skin.

lines.zh: 我拼命往前游，水在响。
lines.en: I swim hard and the water roars around me.

lines.zh: 那一下打在我身上，很沉。
lines.en: That blow landed heavy on my body.

lines.zh: 我的光暗了，游得也慢了。
lines.en: My shine has dimmed and my swimming slows.

lines.zh: 别追了，我快没力气了。
lines.en: Stop chasing; I am nearly out of strength.

lines.zh: 触手断了一条，还能长回来。
lines.en: One tentacle is gone; it will grow back.

lines.zh: 我躲进礁石缝里，不动。
lines.en: I hide in the reef gap and do not move.

lines.zh: 这一下让我记很久。
lines.en: This one I will remember for a long time.

lines.zh: 你手里那点光，晃得我发晕。
lines.en: That glimmer in your hand makes me dizzy.

lines.zh: 我不吃这个，只是被亮吸引。
lines.en: I do not eat this; the brightness draws me.

lines.zh: 你把桶放低一点，我再靠近。
lines.en: Lower the bucket a little, and I will come closer.

lines.zh: 水里的亮片，是你在撒吗？
lines.en: Those bright flakes in the water, are you scattering them?

lines.zh: 我伸出一条触手，先试试。
lines.en: I extend one tentacle to test it first.

lines.zh: 靠太近，我会喷墨跑掉。
lines.en: Too close, and I will ink and flee.

lines.zh: 你不动，我才敢过来。
lines.en: Stay still, and only then will I come.

lines.zh: 那东西在水里转，很好看。
lines.en: That thing turns in the water, and it is pretty.

lines.zh: 我只是想碰一下，不吃。
lines.en: I only want to touch it, not eat it.

lines.zh: 再靠近一点，就是我的极限。
lines.en: One more step and that is my limit.

lines.zh: 你踢到我的触手了，我缩回来。
lines.en: You kicked my tentacle, and I pull it back.

lines.zh: 水被推开，我撞在礁石上。
lines.en: The water shoves me, and I strike the reef.

lines.zh: 你的脚蹼扫过我，很凉。
lines.en: Your flipper sweeps across me, cold and sudden.

lines.zh: 我喷出一股水，退开了。
lines.en: I squirt a jet of water and back away.

lines.zh: 这一撞，我的光闪了一下。
lines.en: At that bump my shine flickered.

lines.zh: 别在水里推我，我会散架。
lines.en: Do not shove me in water; I will come apart.

lines.zh: 我缠住了你的手腕，抱歉。
lines.en: I have wrapped your wrist, and I am sorry.

lines.zh: 沙被我们搅起来了，看不清。
lines.en: We have muddied the sand and cannot see.

lines.zh: 我贴着你的腿滑过去。
lines.en: I slide past your leg, close enough to brush it.

lines.zh: 你的动作太大，水都在响。
lines.en: You move too much; the water is loud with it.

lines.zh: 她的光比我亮，我不敢靠近。
lines.en: Her shine is brighter than mine; I dare not near.

lines.zh: 两只鱿鱼并排，触手交在一起。
lines.en: Two squid side by side, tentacles crossing.

lines.zh: 我们顺着同一股海流漂。
lines.en: We drift along the same current.

lines.zh: 她喷了一下水，我跟上去。
lines.en: She jets water, and I follow after.

lines.zh: 水底的沙窝，是她选的。
lines.en: The hollow in the sand is the one she chose.

lines.zh: 我们的颜色慢慢变成一样。
lines.en: Our colours slowly turn the same.

lines.zh: 这段海沟，以后就是我们的。
lines.en: This trench will be ours from now on.

lines.zh: 她游得比我稳，我学她。
lines.en: She swims steadier than I do, so I copy her.

lines.zh: 有别的鱼靠近，我们一起喷墨。
lines.en: Another fish comes near, and we ink together.

lines.zh: 天亮了，她往深处去了。
lines.en: At dawn she went down into the deep.

lines.zh: 你捡起那片鳞，是我的。
lines.en: You picked up that scale; it is mine.

lines.zh: 水里掉的东西，你能捞到吗？
lines.en: Can you fish out what fell into the water?

lines.zh: 我的触手勾住了你的网。
lines.en: My tentacle has caught in your net.

lines.zh: 那块亮的东西，是我蹭掉的。
lines.en: That shiny piece is what rubbed off me.

lines.zh: 你收起来吧，我还有很多。
lines.en: Put it away; I have plenty more.

lines.zh: 别用手抓，滑得很。
lines.en: Do not grab it with your hand; it is slippery.

lines.zh: 我把它推到沙里藏起来。
lines.en: I push it into the sand to hide it.

lines.zh: 你又捡了一块，是不是喜欢？
lines.en: You picked up another; do you like them?

lines.zh: 那是墨，不是石头。
lines.en: That is ink, not stone.

lines.zh: 我抱着它游不远。
lines.en: Holding it, I cannot swim far.

lines.zh: 水里那点血，把我从深处引上来。
lines.en: That trace of blood draws me up from the deep.

lines.zh: 那道影子比礁石还大。
lines.en: That shadow is bigger than the reef.

lines.zh: 有东西在网后面动。
lines.en: Something moves behind the net.

lines.zh: 我听见船桨划水的声音。
lines.en: I hear oars pulling through the water.

lines.zh: 一群鱼突然全散了。
lines.en: The whole school of fish suddenly scatters.

lines.zh: 那东西在发光，不像我。
lines.en: That thing glows, and not like me.

lines.zh: 水面上的影子停住了。
lines.en: The shadow on the surface has stopped.

lines.zh: 我的触手先感觉到了震动。
lines.en: My tentacles feel the tremor first.

lines.zh: 船桨声停了，网还在动。
lines.en: The oars stopped, but the net is still moving.

lines.zh: 我把自己压进沙里。
lines.en: I press myself down into the sand.

lines.zh: 我盯着它的手，等它下水。
lines.en: I watch its hands and wait for it to enter water.

lines.zh: 它一动，我就往深处退。
lines.en: It moves, and I retreat toward the deep.

lines.zh: 网口朝这边，我得绕过去。
lines.en: The net mouth faces here; I must go around.

lines.zh: 它的速度在水里不快。
lines.en: Its speed in water is not great.

lines.zh: 我算着它换气的间隔。
lines.en: I count the gaps between its breaths.

lines.zh: 礁石后面有条缝，可以走。
lines.en: There is a gap behind the reef I can take.

lines.zh: 它一直看着我，我不动。
lines.en: It keeps watching me, so I stay still.

lines.zh: 我把触手收紧，准备喷水。
lines.en: I draw my tentacles in, ready to jet.

lines.zh: 它要是伸手，我就往左跑。
lines.en: If it reaches out, I bolt to the left.

lines.zh: 等它靠近到三步之内。
lines.en: Wait until it is within three steps.

lines.zh: 我用触手抽了它一下。
lines.en: I lashed it once with a tentacle.

lines.zh: 墨喷出去，水一下黑了。
lines.en: The ink goes out and the water turns black.

lines.zh: 它抓住我的触手，我用力挣。
lines.en: It grabs my tentacle, and I wrench free.

lines.zh: 我的力气不大，只能拖住它。
lines.en: I am not strong; I can only slow it down.

lines.zh: 这一下让它松了手。
lines.en: That blow made it let go.

lines.zh: 我撞在它胸口，滑开了。
lines.en: I strike its chest and slide off.

lines.zh: 触手上的吸盘留下了印子。
lines.en: My suckers left marks on its skin.

lines.zh: 我一边退一边喷墨。
lines.en: I retreat and ink as I go.

lines.zh: 别以为我只会逃。
lines.en: Do not think I only know how to flee.

lines.zh: 打完之后，我马上就走。
lines.en: When it is done, I leave at once.

lines.zh: 我在海面下睁开了眼。
lines.en: I opened my eyes beneath the sea surface.

lines.zh: 这片海太亮，我往深处去。
lines.en: This sea is too bright; I head deeper.

lines.zh: 我刚出生，触手还很短。
lines.en: I am newly born, and my tentacles are short.

lines.zh: 沙里有个坑，是我的。
lines.en: There is a hollow in the sand, and it is mine.

lines.zh: 周围没有别的鱿鱼。
lines.en: There are no other squid around me.

lines.zh: 我第一次喷水，喷歪了。
lines.en: My first jet of water went the wrong way.

lines.zh: 水草在我身上绕了一圈。
lines.en: A strand of weed has wound around me.

lines.zh: 上面有光，下面什么都没有。
lines.en: Light above, nothing at all below.

lines.zh: 我慢慢沉到礁石旁边。
lines.en: I sink slowly down beside the reef.

lines.zh: 这片海沟，我记住了。
lines.en: I have memorized this trench.

lines.zh: 水被烧热了，我往深处沉。
lines.en: The water turns hot, and I sink deeper.

lines.zh: 离开了水，我的触手拍在沙上。
lines.en: Out of water, my tentacles slap the sand.

lines.zh: 我本就住在水里，这次却喘不上气。
lines.en: I live in water, yet now I cannot breathe.

lines.zh: 冲击把水推成墙，我撞上去。
lines.en: The blast makes a wall of water, and I hit it.

lines.zh: 一支箭射进水里，变慢了。
lines.en: An arrow comes into the water, slowing as it goes.

lines.zh: 那道法术让我全身发麻。
lines.en: That spell leaves my whole body numb.

lines.zh: 水里没有小鱼，我饿得发轻。
lines.en: No small fish in the water; hunger makes me light.

lines.zh: 雷打进海里，我全身一颤。
lines.en: Lightning strikes the sea, and my whole body jolts.

lines.zh: 水没有了，我在空气里下坠。
lines.en: The water is gone, and I fall through air.
